name: Data Analyzer: Health check needs no API key
objective: Shows that the health check can be used without credentials even when a key is configured.
precondition: Server application loaded offline with a made-up API key and admin password configured.

steps.action: Request the health check with no key.
steps.expected: HTTP 200; reply contains status, version and services.

name: Data Analyzer: Key check refuses a missing key
objective: Shows that the key-checking routine rejects a call with no key. It is called directly rather than through a web request.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured (this check calls the key-checking routine directly, not through a web request).

steps.action: Run the key check with no key.
steps.expected: The check raises an error whose text contains '401' or 'Authentication required'.

name: Data Analyzer: Key check refuses a wrong key
objective: Shows that the key-checking routine rejects a wrong key (called directly).
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured (this check calls the key-checking routine directly, not through a web request).

steps.action: Run the key check with the key 'wrong-key'.
steps.expected: The check raises an error whose text contains '403' or 'Invalid credentials'.

name: Data Analyzer: Key check accepts the correct key
objective: Shows that the correct key is accepted (called directly).
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured (this check calls the key-checking routine directly, not through a web request).

steps.action: Run the key check with the configured made-up key.
steps.expected: The check returns that same key.

name: Data Analyzer: With no key configured, the key check lets everything through
objective: Shows the designed behaviour that authentication is switched off when no key is configured (so an unconfigured deployment is open).
precondition: Server application reloaded with all environment settings cleared, so no API key exists.

steps.action: Run the key check with no key.
steps.expected: The check returns the label 'unauthenticated' (access allowed).

name: Data Analyzer: Admin check refuses a missing password
objective: Shows that the administrator check rejects a call with no password (called directly).
precondition: Server application reloaded with a made-up admin password configured.

steps.action: Run the admin check with no password.
steps.expected: The check raises an error whose text contains '401' or 'Admin authentication required'.

name: Data Analyzer: Admin check refuses a wrong password
objective: Shows that a wrong administrator password is rejected (called directly).
precondition: Server application reloaded with a made-up admin password configured.

steps.expected: The check raises an error whose text contains '403' or 'Invalid admin credentials'.

name: Data Analyzer: Admin check accepts the correct password
objective: Shows that the correct administrator password is accepted (called directly).
precondition: Server application reloaded with a made-up admin password configured.

steps.action: Run the admin check with the configured made-up password.
steps.expected: The check returns that same password.

name: Data Analyzer: With no admin password configured, admin access is refused with HTTP 503
objective: Shows the product fails safe: if no admin password has been configured, admin actions are denied rather than silently allowed (an earlier version let everything through).
precondition: Server application reloaded with all environment settings cleared.

steps.action: Run the admin check with no password.
steps.expected: The check is refused with an HTTP 503 (service unavailable) error. Returning any value would fail the test.

name: Data Analyzer: Missing-key refusal carries the 'ApiKey' challenge header
objective: Shows that when a key is missing, the refusal is HTTP 401 and tells the caller which kind of credential is needed.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness; the configured API key is set to a made-up value for this test (this check calls the key-checking routine directly, not through a web request).

steps.action: Run the key check with no key and inspect the refusal.
steps.expected: A refusal IS raised (if none were raised the test now fails), with status 401 and a WWW-Authenticate header equal to 'ApiKey'.

name: Data Analyzer: Missing-password refusal carries the 'AdminPassword' challenge header
objective: Shows that when the admin password is missing, the refusal is HTTP 401 and names the credential type.
precondition: Server application loaded offline; the configured admin password is set to a made-up value for this test (direct call, not a web request).

steps.action: Run the admin check with no password and inspect the refusal.
steps.expected: A refusal IS raised (if none were raised the test now fails), with status 401 and a WWW-Authenticate header equal to 'AdminPassword'.

name: Data Analyzer: Refusal messages are generic and do not reveal the key or its setting name
objective: Shows that error text does not leak secrets. Note: each part passes silently if no refusal is raised.
precondition: Server application loaded in the offline test harness with a made-up API key configured (this check calls the key-checking routine directly, not through a web request).

steps.action: Run the key check with no key.
steps.expected: If refused: message includes 'Authentication required' and does not include 'API_KEY' or the real key.

steps.action: Run the key check with the wrong key 'wrong'.
steps.expected: If refused: message includes 'Invalid credentials' and does not include the real key or the wrong key typed.
